case_number: 2024 INSC 138; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 472 OF 2012, 479 OF 2012, 476-478 OF 2012, SLP(Crl.) No. 1379 of 2011

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Interplay between Food Safety and Standards Act (FSSA) and IPC Sections 272-273; FSSA has overriding effect post-29.07.2010 on food-related laws; same act cannot be punished under both IPC and special food laws; unsafe food definition broader than adulteration; preponderance vs beyond reasonable doubt standard; offences registered post-FSSA enforcement; prosecution under IPC for food adulteration barred once FSSA provisions apply; quashing petitions concerning dual prosecution jurisdiction.
legal_provisions_cited: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 s.89
final_judgment: Allowing appeals; High Court orders declining to quash FIRs set aside; prosecution under IPC provisions for food adulteration barred post-FSSA enforcement; exclusive jurisdiction under special food law.
